name: Halberd
description: A halberd, 2.25 m from butt to spike (the long class of polearms, 2 m and more): an ash shaft on an iron butt spike with two leather wraps, iron langets up to a socket, an axe blade with a straight steel edge, a hooked back fluke and a long thrusting spike. It stands on its butt as held, shaft along +z and edge to +x.
